Which of the following method(s) can be used to change the direction of force on a current carrying conductor?

(i) Changing the magnitude of current

(ii) Changing the strength of magnetic field

(iii) Changing the direction of current
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (iii).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** direction of force** on a current carrying conductor can be** changed **by changing the **direction of current **flowing through it.
 
• The direction of force on a current carrying conductor is given by **Fleming left-hand rule.**
 
• This rule states that if the** thumb, forefinger, and middle finger **of the left hand are held** mutually perpendicular** to each other, with the** forefinger pointing** in the direction of the **magnetic field** and the** thumb** points in the direction of the **force **acting on the conductor.**,** then the **middle finger **points in the direction of the current. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Changing the magnitude of current also **affects the force** on the conductor.

 
 
• Greater the current, **greater **will be the force.
 
 
 
• Changing the** strength of magnetic field** also affects the force on the conductor.
 
 
• **Stronger** the magnetic field, greater will be the force.
 
 
 
• An external factor called** force** has the power to alter a body's state of motion or rest.
 
• It has a **direction** and a** magnitude.**
 
• The **Newton** is the S.I. unit of force.

questions.question: ___________ is defined as the output per unit of variable input.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Average product.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Average product** is a measure of productivity that calculates the **output per unit of variable input.**
 
• It is calculated by **dividing total product **by the** number of units of variable input**.
 
• The average product rises in proportion to the average productivity of input, and the more productive the input, the **higher the average product.**
 
• In general, there is a** linear relationship **between input factors and total production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Total product** is the total output produced by a firm using a **specific amount of input**.

 
 
• Formula for the Total Product is: TP is equal to** AP*L, **where L is labor and AP is the product/labor unit.
 
 
 
• **Marginal product** is the additional output produced by using one more unit of input.
 
 
• Therefore, **changed output / changed input** equals marginal product.
 
• In other words, with the assistance of more labor or material, marginal product **increases total product.**

questions.question: If the base area of a right circular cylinder is 346.50 cm2 and its height is 21 cm, then find its total surface area. [USE π = (22)/(7)]
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Radius r = √(Base Area × 7 ÷ 22) = √(346.5 × 7 ÷ 22) = 10.5 cm

Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r × h = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 10.5 × 21 = 1386 cm²

Total Surface Area = 2 × Base Area + Curved Surface Area

Total Surface Area = (2 × 346.5) + 1386 = 693 + 1386 = 2079 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2079 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base area of the right circular cylinder = 346.50 cm²

Height of the cylinder (h) = 21 cm

**Formulas Used:**

Base Area = π × r²

Total Surface Area = 2 × π × r × (r + h)

Total Surface Area = (2 × Base Area) + (2 × π × r × h)

 h = 21 cm
 Base Area = 346.5 cm²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base Area = π × r² = 346.50

⇒ (22 ÷ 7) × r² = 346.50

⇒ r² = 346.50 × (7 ÷ 22)

⇒ r² = 110.25

⇒ r = √110.25 = 10.5 cm

⇒ Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ Curved Surface Area = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 10.5 × 21

⇒ Curved Surface Area = 44 × 1.5 × 21 = 1386 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = (2 × Base Area) + Curved Surface Area

⇒ Total Surface Area = (2 × 346.50) + 1386

⇒ Total Surface Area = 693 + 1386 = 2079 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2079 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area vs Curved Surface Area

Curved Surface Area (CSA) includes only the lateral surface of the cylinder (2 × π × r × h). Total Surface Area (TSA) includes the CSA plus both the circular top and bottom bases (2 × π × r × h + 2 × π × r²).

Volume of a Right Circular Cylinder

The volume represents the total capacity of the cylinder and is calculated by multiplying the base area by its height. The formula is V = π × r² × h.

Divisibility by 11 Shortcut

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about soil formation?

options.text: Temperature and rainfall influence rate of weathering.
Time determines thickness of soil profile.
Altitude and slope determine the rate of humus formation.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is 'Altitude and slope determine the rate of humus formation.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Altitude and slope:**

 
 
• While altitude and slope can affect various soil properties, they do not directly determine the rate of humus formation.
 
• Humus formation is primarily influenced by organic matter decomposition, microbial activity, and environmental conditions such as temperature and moisture.
 
• Steep slopes may lead to increased soil erosion, which can reduce the accumulation of organic matter, but this is an indirect effect rather than a determinant of humus formation rate.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperature and rainfall influence rate of weathering:**

 
 
• These factors significantly impact the weathering processes of rocks and minerals, leading to soil formation. High temperatures accelerate chemical weathering, while rainfall aids in physical weathering and transportation of materials.
 
• Both chemical and physical weathering are essential for breaking down parent rock materials into finer soil particles.
 
 
 
• **Time determines thickness of soil profile:**
 
 
• The length of time affects soil maturity and profile development. Over extended periods, soils undergo various processes like leaching, accumulation of organic material, and horizon differentiation, leading to thicker soil profiles.
 
• Longer periods allow for the development of distinct soil horizons, such as the accumulation of humus in the topsoil or clay in subsoils.
 
 
 
• **Parent rock determines colour:**
 
 
• The mineral composition of the parent rock influences the colour of the soil. For instance, soils derived from iron-rich parent materials are usually reddish, while those from limestone are often whitish or grey.
 
• Other factors like organic matter content and soil moisture also influence soil colour but the parent material provides the fundamental mineralogical base.

questions.question: What does a self-sustaining ecosystem mean?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Energy availability: **In practically all societies,** light from the sun **serves as the primary energy source.
 
• **Nutritional availability: saprotrophic decomposers** guarantee that inorganic nutrients are continuously **recycled **in an ecosystem.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT Mendel's pea plant experiments?

options.text: Appearance of both the tallness and shortness traits in F2 progeny indicated that both the traits were inherited in the F1 plants.
In the second-generation, or F2 generation which are the progeny of the F1 tall plants, all the plants are tall.
Mendel used a number of contrasting visible characters of garden peas – round/wrinkled seeds, tall/short plants.
He took a tall plant and a short plant, produced progeny by crossing them and in the resulting F1 progeny, all plants were tall.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**In the second-generation, or F2 generation which are the progeny of the F1 tall plants, all the plants are tall.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mendel's pea plant** experiments are considered as the foundation of **modern genetics.**
 
• Mendel used a number of contrasting visible characters of garden peas such as **round/wrinkled seeds, yellow/green pods, and tall/short plants.**
 
• He took a tall plant and a short plant, produced **progeny by crossing them** and in the resulting** F1 progeny,** all plants were tall.
 
• This indicated that the **tall trait** was dominant over the short trait.
 
• In the second-generation, or F2 generation, which are the progeny of the F1 tall plants, the plants exhibited a** 3:1 ratio of tall to short plants**.
 
• This was because the F1 plants were **heterozygous**, meaning they carried one dominant and one recessive allele for the trait.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A great deal of the **genetic code** was developed by Mendel's pea plant research, which he carried out between **1856 and 1863.**
 
• These days, it's known as the **Mendelian inheritance laws.**
 
• Mendel created the terms **"recessive" and "dominant"** in regard to particular features in order to describe this phenomena. 
 
• His research, which was published in **1866,** showed how **genes**—now known as unseen "factors"—predictably determine an organism's features.

questions.question: A heating device of power 1100 W is designed to operate at 220 V line voltage. If on a particular day the line voltage drops to 110 V, then the current through it and its output power will be _______ and _______.

**Step 1: Find the resistance of the heating device**

 
• Using the formula for power:
 
• Power = Voltage² / Resistance
 
• Solving for resistance: Resistance = Voltage² / Power = 220² / 1100 = 48400 / 1100 = 44 Ω

**Step 2: Calculate the current at 220 V**

 
• Using Power = Voltage × Current, the current at 220 V is:
 
• Current = Power / Voltage = 1100 / 220 = 5 A

• Now, calculate the current when the voltage drops to 110 V using Current = Voltage / Resistance:
 
• Current = 110 / 44 = 2.5 A

**Step 4: Calculate the output power at 110 V**

 
• Finally, calculate the output power at 110 V using Power = Current² × Resistance:
 
• Power = (2.5)² × 44 = 6.25 × 44 = 275 W

**Final Answer:**

 
• The current through the device is 2.5 A.
 
• The output power is 275 W.

questions.question: What is the relation between m, v, and u for a spherical mirror ?

where f is the **focal length** of the mirror.

**m = -v/u**

where m is the** magnification** of the mirror.

However, if we define the magnification as the ratio of the size of the image to the size of the object, then we get:

**m = v/u**

This is because the **negative sign** in the mirror formula indicates that the image is **inverted**. So, by convention, the magnification is taken as **negative** for an inverted image.
